_status: RC3 (AVR-386): the upstream versions Home's adapters are contract-tested against. Each digest must equal the one in its compose file (tests/test_compose_image_pins.py); tests/media_upstream_live.py reads the version here and fails when the running image reports another. Changing a digest therefore means changing this file and re-running upstream-contracts.yml. A digest here proves what CI ran, not what the host runs: live state is E1, 2026-10-30.
